sources.researchNote: The work overview names MORELL (D) under composer/arranger and records the title variants “Dodo” and “Qui sait.” The Austrian-version table lists Fritz Rotter as lyricist, Hermann Scheibenhofer (protected shares) as composer, Edition Charles Brüll as original publisher, and Universal Music Publishing Austria GmbH as subpublisher. The AKM entry does not itself expand Morell to Bronisław Kaper; that identity is resolved through the same-work evidence represented by SRC0288.

sources.fullCitation: AKM/AUME Werke suchen, work entry for O Madonna, Werknummer 30566, version 1, ISWC T-800.157.511-8, ISRC DEU240405411. From the film Ein Lied fuer Dich. Music credited to Walter Jurmann and Bronislaw Kaper. Original publisher: Wiener Boheme-Verlag Edition. Listed lyricists: Ernst Marischka and Fritz Rotter. Subpublishers: UMP / Wiener Boheme.
